title: DocumentUploadedEvent
description: document.uploaded: published by the document service on the document-events topic and forwarded to the extraction-jobs queue, where the worker reads it as its job. message_id is doc_id. Either blob_name or blob_url must be non-empty.

event_type.description: Absent on messages queued by upload-service 1.x.

blob_name.description: Preferred source location, within blob_container. Older messages carry only blob_url.

not.description: Neither blob_name nor blob_url is set.
